column1: # Frog species with a sequenced genome -> genome assembly for AMP mapping.
# VERIFY accessions before running (assembly versions change). Fetch with the
# NCBI `datasets` CLI: datasets download genome accession <ACCESSION>.
# has_genome=yes species are mapping targets; a genus column routes AMPs whose
# APD record names only the genus, or whose family implies it.
# Columns: species            taxid   genus       accession          assembly            has_genome  notes
# Genome-less genera commonly seen in APD frog entries (AMPs set aside, not mapped):
# Phyllomedusa (dermaseptins/phylloseptins), Pelophylax (esculentins; use Rana as proxy only if you accept cross-species), Hyla, Odorrana, Hylarana, Agalychnis
